opportunity.Name: Acme Legal - Renewal & Expansion FY26
opportunity.Loss_Reason__c: Competitor demoed native in-Word contract review with fast redlining; paralegal team responded positively

Notes.Body: Renewal call. GC (Priya Nair) proactively raised LegalEdge. They demoed a new contract review module ~3 weeks ago. Key draw: everything runs natively inside Word - redlining happens in Word, no separate app. Paralegals liked the redline speed on a live MSA.

Follow-up internal note: Priya emphasized this was a demo, not a pilot. Reliability of our integration for audits still valued. Pricing only mentioned informally by LegalEdge - do not over-index on it. Real stickiness risk is the in-Word paralegal UX.
Head of KM (Marcus Webb) wants roadmap that reflects how paralegals actually work; requested direct time between our team and his paralegals. Action: AE to share drafting roadmap before renewal.

raw_text: A Salesforce renewal/expansion opportunity for Acme Legal (FY26, ~$148K, Negotiation/Review) flags LegalEdge as a competitor. Logged notes across three dates describe: LegalEdge demoing a newly launched contract review module ~3 weeks prior; its main draw being fully native operation inside Microsoft Word (redlining in Word, no separate app) with fast redlining demonstrated on a live master services agreement; the paralegal team responding positively; the customer stressing this was a demo not a pilot; Litera's integration reliability still valued for audits; pricing mentioned only informally; and the customer's Head of Knowledge Management requesting a roadmap that reflects paralegal workflows plus direct time with his paralegals.
